Closing Auction Alpha Research

SET · SGX · HKEX — diagnostic event studies and causally valid, cost-aware backtests

1. Strategy leaderboard

Base scenario, all non-holdout dates. Parameters were selected on the discovery period only; validation and OOS columns are out-of-sample for that choice. q = Benjamini–Hochberg across every grid point tested. Click a header to sort.

2. Gross versus net performance

Annualised Sharpe from daily portfolio returns (fixed capital), before and after all transaction, borrow and funding costs.

3. Equity curves and drawdowns

Curves are sampled to at most 400 points for display (drawdown keeps each interval's worst value); full daily series are in studies/<S>_<MKT>/daily_<scenario>.parquet.

4. Closing-gap distributions

gap = ln(closing-auction price / last continuous price), clipped to ±500 bps for display.

5. Event study: cumulative abnormal returns after closing gaps

Diagnostic — not executable. Signed for reversal (S01 threshold); market-adjusted; date-clustered. Windows starting at C0 assume a trade at the closing price, which is only possible via SGX TAC.

6. Heatmaps by market, year and signal threshold

Left: net yearly return (% of capital, base) of each selected study. Right: grid of the chosen study's primary parameter × year (all values tested; only discovery years drove the selection).

7. Index rebalance event analysis

Mean cumulative abnormal return around the index trade day (day 0 = close before the effective date). Diagnostic.

8. Long versus short attribution

Total P&L as % of capital by book (base scenario). Short trades that could not be borrowed were rejected and contribute nothing.

9. Transaction-cost sensitivity

Fees, spread and impact scaled together; 1.0 = base assumptions, 0 = frictionless.

10. Fill probability and capacity scenarios

11. Data quality and missing data

Data availability and strategy support

12. Trade and event drill-down

Largest closing-gap events (diagnostic, this study)

Rejected and reduced orders (base scenario)

Robustness checks for this study

Pipeline validation (synthetic only)

Fractions of the closing gap the generator planted to revert, and what the pipeline estimated from the generated prices. Agreement shows the plumbing works; it says nothing about real markets.
